map.输入喷头 RTI 值、气流温度、气流速度等参数，计算闭式喷头在火场中的响应动作时: Enter the sprinkler RTI value, gas temperature, gas velocity and other parameters to compute the response/actuation time of a closed sprinkler head in a fire.
map.闭式喷头响应时间 t = (RTI÷√u)·ln[(Tg−Ti)/(Tg−Tac: Sprinkler response time t = (RTI/√u)·ln[(Tg−Ti)/(Tg−Tact)]: RTI = Response Time Index, u = gas velocity, Tg = gas temperature, Ti = initial temperature, Tact = activation temperature; time constant τ = RTI/√u.
map.💡 公式：t = (RTI / √u) × ln[(Tg − Ti) / (Tg: 💡 Formula: t = (RTI / √u) × ln[(Tg − Ti) / (Tg − Tact)]; where τ = RTI/√u is the sprinkler time constant.
map.仅当 Tg > Tact > Ti 时喷头才会动作，否则提示无法启动。: The sprinkler actuates only when Tg > Tact > Ti, otherwise it prompts that it cannot start.
map.RTI 反映喷头热敏性：快速响应喷头 RTI≤50，标准响应 RTI≈80~10: RTI reflects the sprinkler's thermal sensitivity: quick-response sprinklers have RTI≤50 and standard-response RTI≈80-100.
map.气流速度 u 取顶棚射流平均速度，通常 1~3 m/s。: Gas velocity u takes the average ceiling-jet velocity, usually 1-3 m/s.

map.RTI=50 喷头在 300℃ 烟气中的动作时间: Actuation time of an RTI=50 sprinkler in 300℃ smoke
map.按默认参数（RTI=50 (m·s)^0.5、气流温度 300 ℃、气流速度 2: With the default parameters (RTI=50 (m·s)^0.5, gas temperature 300 ℃, gas velocity 2.0 m/s, initial 20 ℃, actuation temperature 68 ℃): time constant τ = RTI/√u = 50/1.414 = 35.4 s; ln[(Tg−Ti)/(Tg−Tact)] = ln[280/232] = 0.1881; response/actuation time = 35.4 × 0.1881 = 6.65 s, rated quick response. If the gas velocity is reduced to 0.5 m/s, τ rises to 70.7 s and the actuation time doubles to 13.3 s.
map.RTI 是什么，数值多大算快速响应？: What is RTI, and what value counts as quick response?
map.响应时间指数 RTI 综合反映热敏元件的热惯性与传: The Response Time Index RTI comprehensively reflects the thermal inertia and heat transfer
map.，单位为 (m·s)^0.5，数值越小响应越快。通常 RTI≤50 为快速响应喷: , with the unit (m·s)^0.5, and the smaller the value the faster the response. Typically RTI≤50 is a quick-response sprinkler, 50-80 special response and 80-350 standard response.
map.气流速度越大喷头就越快动作吗？: Does a higher gas velocity always actuate the sprinkler faster?
map.在公式层面是的——τ=RTI/√u，气流速度越大传热越快。但顶棚高速气流也可能把: At the level of the formula, yes — τ=RTI/√u, so the greater the gas velocity the faster the heat transfer. But a high-speed ceiling jet may also blow hot smoke away from the sprinkler and lower the temperature around it; in engineering, CFD simulation or physical testing should be used rather than relying on the formula alone.
